title: Tell a Biology Story in Two Minutes
objective: Students turn a biology article, video, picture, or experience into a short spoken story.
context: Story notes: walked to the pond; heard a splash; saw a frog jump into the water; felt curious.

items.prompt: Choose up to six key words for your story.
items.answer: Accept key words such as pond, walked, splash, frog, jump, curious.

items.prompt: Tell your partner what happened. Use three time words.
items.answer: Listen for a clear beginning, middle and end with three suitable linking words.

items.prompt: End by saying why the event interested you.
items.answer: Accept one personal reason linked to the story.
items.hint: Start with: This interested me because ___.
